name: Asahina Tsubaki
source:
Birth Date: 1985/12/31

Tsubaki is the 5th son of the Asahina family. He’s a young seiyuu working as a set with his beloved twin [url=/c12972]Azusa[/url]. While he’s usually playful and easygoing, Tsubaki actually has a serious side as well. Especially when it comes to work. He takes his job very seriously, and he always does his best at work. Tsubaki is also an otaku who loves anime, manga and games. He loves little sister characters with a passion, so [url=/c10574]Ema[/url] is a dream come true for him.

[from [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2012/06/07/brothers-conflict-passion-pink-tsubaki/]Love-Colored Sky[/url]]
